items.subject: AVX2 arithmetic-classification decoder
items.objective: In its own research branch, modify only src/candidate.cpp to evaluate an AVX2 decoder whose primary mapping method is vector range classification and arithmetic offsets, followed by vector bit packing—not a wide table-permute lookup. Use safe block loads/stores and a correct tail/padding path; verify ISA support under the frozen build without changing flags. Preserve exact output semantics and stay within the threads budget. Validate empty and short strings plus lengths around vector-block boundaries, all padding cases, random valid inputs, and the official Lena input before repeated native timing. Do not specialize to its length; record failures and results.
